The text names an album by the Beatles. Which of these songs was first released on it?

Text: The Beatles (White Album)

Allowed answers:
- The End
- Yer Blues
- Money (That's What I Want)
- Please Please Me

message.content: Both "The End" and "Yer Blues" are on the White Album, but "Yer Blues" is the correct pick among these since both appear there—however, only one answer allowed: "Yer Blues" was first released on the White Album (as was "The End"). Choosing "Yer Blues".
